title: Infrastructure banner disclosed (X-Varnish header)
description: The response discloses a X-Varnish header banner. Infrastructure banners map the stack for attackers. This check matches the banner directly.
remediation: Immediate: remove the header at the component that adds it — reverse proxy, CDN, cache tier or application platform — or strip it with a response-header rule at the edge. Durable: normalise hop-by-hop and platform headers centrally so a new deployment cannot reintroduce them, and keep that detail in logs rather than in responses. The value reveals stack vintage or cache topology, so treat it as configuration hygiene rather than evidence of an exploitable defect.
limitation: Banner check: version visibility alone is not exploitability.
